text:
Maya: Quick follow-up from DD-482 board meeting 1: recurring KV eviction under bursty traffic. Need concrete owners for: regression test, promptset (cache-thrash), focused load profile, and a chaos drill.

Leo: I can take the regression test and CI gating. Will create a tracking ticket INF-4112. ETA 9d.

Aria: I'll own the promptset and quality thresholds. Plan: short repro + long-conversation that provokes KV churn. Will add to evals repo and link to INF-4113.

Maya: Leo, ensure the regression asserts eviction_rate and session_miss_ratio. Fail the job if eviction_rate > 0.08 for longer than 45s.

Leo: Will add PromQL checks and a small synthetic client. Snippet I'll include in PR: ```bash
go test ./tests/kv_bench -run Evict -concurrency 10000 -duration 4m
```

oncall-bot: Postmortem DD-482 recorded: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-482/postmortem (automated)

DevInfra: For load testing, we should reproduce the burst shape with a multi-region producer + regional RTT emulation. I can provide terraform and ephemeral clients.

Aria: Promptset details: two files - repro_short.json and repro_long.json. repro_long will include repeated turns to exercise prefix caching. I'll include expected embedding drift tolerances.

Ritu: I'll run the chaos drill orchestration. Proposed date: 2029-05-10 17:00 UTC. Drill plan: during spike, inject 20% node restarts + intermittent 200ms network delays between zones.

Maya: Ownership recap: Leo -> regression + CI (INF-4112), Aria -> promptset & eval thresholds (INF-4113), DevInfra -> load infra, Ritu -> chaos drill + runbook. I'll parent these under INF-4110.

Leo: Small ask: add eviction metrics to test harness and export to CI logs. That way failures show exact time windows.

Aria: I'll add a README with pass/fail criteria and a small sample seed so CI runs deterministically.

DevInfra: Also recommend a canary routing policy fallback during drill to limit impact (smaller kv cache size). I can add a feature-flagged variant.

Maya: OK. Keep PRs linked here and update Jira. We'll review in next oncall sync. Ping if blocked. :white_check_mark:
